title: SubmissionTypeDecidedPayload
description: Payload of the SubmissionTypeDecided event (class: domain), which gives payload-svc the submission type that submission-svc decided (derivation step 9), so that payload-svc never re-derives it (INV-REQ-416) and canonical-svc never knows it (INV-REQ-479); INV-Q-6990 A. Dedupe key: docUuid plus version (FR-M.12). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required. A version with no decided type has no event (INV-Q-7001). The submissionType spelling is TYPE_1A, TYPE_1B, TYPE_2, TYPE_3; the PayloadReady payload spells the type 1A, 1B, 2, 3 and the boundary mapping lives in payload-svc.

version.description: The canonical/payload/submission version number the type was decided for.

docsequence.description: The per-document monotonic sequence (INV-REQ-1221), duplicated in the payload alongside the envelope's own docsequence extension attribute.

submissionType.description: The submission type decided by submission-svc (INV-REQ-415).
